headline: Europe Auto Sector Posts Fastest Output Growth in Over Five Years
summary: Automotive manufacturing output in Europe registered its fastest growth rate in more than five years.
why: Industrial production figures for the European auto sector serve as a key gauge of regional manufacturing health and economic activity.

impacts.name: European Auto Sector
impacts.why: Output growth reached a five-year high across European automotive manufacturing.
